capabilities: Collapse and expand code blocks in preview mode via a toggle button
Configure the number of lines visible when collapsed
Customize collapse/expand icons and default collapse state
Enable horizontal scrolling for code blocks
Control default collapse state per note via frontmatter
extras: README covers features, installation, usage, settings, and per-note frontmatter control; no troubleshooting or known-limitations section.
motivation: The README says the plugin enhances readability of notes by allowing users to collapse long code blocks they don't need to see in full.
problem: Long code blocks in preview mode take up a lot of vertical space, making notes harder to read when the code content is not needed.
summary: Collapsible code blocks plugin that adds collapse/expand toggles, configurable visible lines, and horizontal scrolling to code blocks in preview mode.
